scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @careeros/domain && npm run build -w @careeros/agents && npm run build -w @careeros/data
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @careeros/api && npm run build -w @careeros/worker && npm run build -w @careeros/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @careeros/api" "npm run dev -w @careeros/worker" "npm run dev -w @careeros/web" "npm run dev:discovery -w @careeros/api"
